Read `.artifacts_state.json`, degrading to an empty list on anything unusable.

Source: R/agent_artifacts.R
dot-cv_read_artifacts_state.Rd

Round LV (Batch 5a): this five-line read-with-fallback appeared verbatim in three places after Round LIV added the index (cv_index_object_artifacts, cv_sync_object_artifacts, cv_build_manifest) plus a fourth variant in cv_materialize_pending_artifact. Own duplication, introduced one round ago and collapsed here — the state file is read on every turn and every download, so "what counts as an unreadable state file" is exactly the decision that should not have four independent answers.

Usage

.cv_read_artifacts_state(artifacts_dir)

Arguments

artifacts_dir

session artifacts dir.

Value

the parsed state list, or an empty list.
